# aws-messaging

SQS dead-letter queues and redrive, SNS encryption and subscription lifecycle, EventBridge rule/target wiring - the delivery guarantees the MESSAGING rules measure.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-MSG-001` — SQS queue declares no dead-letter redrive policy (high)

A queue without `RedrivePolicy` drops poison messages after the receive-count budget — the failed message disappears with the reason it failed. The dump records the attribute's absence, so the rule fires on a measured fact, not a guess.

Remediation: Attach a dead-letter queue with `maxReceiveCount` sized to the consumer's retry budget; alert on `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` in the DLQ.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-dead-letter-queues.html

### `AF-MSG-002` — SNS topic declares no KMS encryption (medium)

`KmsMasterKeyId` absent means the topic relies on the default — messages at rest are not encrypted under a customer-managed key. The attribute is declared in the dump, so absence is measured.

Remediation: Set a customer-managed KMS key on the topic and grant publishers `kms:GenerateDataKey` + `kms:Decrypt` on it.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-server-side-encryption.html

### `AF-MSG-003` — SNS subscription stuck in PendingConfirmation (medium)

A subscription ARN containing `PendingConfirmation` never receives messages — the integration is silently dead until confirmed.

Remediation: Confirm the subscription or delete it; alert when a subscription stays pending past the provisioning window.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-delivery-retries.html

### `AF-MSG-004` — Enabled EventBridge rule has no targets (medium)

An ENABLED rule with an empty target list matches events and discards them — the wiring exists, the delivery does not.

Remediation: Attach at least one target or disable the rule; a deliberate catch-and-drop belongs in the event pattern, not in an empty target list.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules.html
